name: Bay Area Biking Maps & Trails
description: Free bike trail and bikeway maps for the Bay Area in one place
fullDescription: 511.org gathers bike trail maps and city and county bikeway maps from across the Bay Area, along with tips on bike safety, bike parking, and taking bikes on transit and bridges.
whatTheyOffer:
- Links to regional trail maps (Bay Trail, Ridge Trail, Bay Bridge Trail, Transit to Trails)
- City and county bike maps for about 30 Bay Area communities
- Bike safety and riding-in-traffic tips
- Info on bike parking and bikes on transit, bridges, and tunnels
- Links to local bicycle coalitions
howToGetIt:
1. Visit 511.org's Biking Maps & Trails page
2. Pick a regional trail map or search for your city or county map
3. Open the map from the local agency or trail organization
keywords: bike map, cycling, bicycle, trails, route planner, 511, bike path, bike lane, commute, recreation
